need.text: 每一幕他都离我更近一点。

answer.note_zh: 这是一条跨三幕的关系，不是对某一个东西的修改：每一幕他的脚都要比上一幕离床更近。按画面的纵深（衣柜 640 < 窗边 708 ≈ 屋子中间 712 < 床尾 858 < 床头 872），第二幕不能在衣柜、床头，也不会不在；「一点」说的是一步步匀着走近，中点约 756，最像屋子中间。所以我改的是我自己的信念，不替你选：第二幕我现在够有把握，不用再问你了。
answer.note_en: A relation across the three beats, not an edit to one thing: each beat his feet are closer to the bed than the last. By the picture's depth (wardrobe 640 < window 708 ≈ middle of the room 712 < foot of the bed 858 < bedside 872) the second beat cannot be the wardrobe or the bedside, nor gone; "a little" says even steps, and the midpoint, about 756, is most like the middle of the room. So I revise my own belief rather than pick for you: about the second beat I am now sure enough not to ask.
